_about: Fixture for the Kompara v4 kit (the simple launch set). It is the v3 kit's fixture, unchanged, plus the `v4` block. Raw inputs only; check.py derives every displayed figure and asserts it inside its frame.

rojo_negativo._note: C7: negative deciding amount; la regla keeps its 240×100 plate (Round 14): the band's insets go 12/12 and the figures are tracked tighter, minus kerned to the $; no growth step, nothing shrinks

today_by_app._note: Round 24c: the whole 19 oct is Uber (see today_by_app_1440)

h5b_partial_import._note: the statement covers 7 days; the reader was installed on 2026-10-01 and saw 4

cohort._note: mean = sum_driver_per_trip / drivers; the median is the 50th decile; percentile by linear interpolation between deciles

imss.source: CONASAMI tabla 2026 · DOF nota 5777156 (ejemplo, regla pendiente)

plan.banked_days_rule: on a failed renewal: Play grace period first, then the banked promotional days (premium_until − purchase_date), then access ends

b6_partial_support._note: a DiDi-unsupported day; net is given, not derived

E3c_sept_mixed._about: Explicitly labelled alternate: the reader active from 2026-09-21; the 14–20 sep import (no km) sits in the same month

floors_per_hour_example._note: Ejemplo — only C5, a driver who chose Por hora in Tu meta y tu mínimo; not part of the 19 oct timeline (that driver decides by km)

today_afternoon_trips._note: Round 19 (Opus R19-M1): the two newest D1 rows, split out of shift 2 so each shows its own rate; shift 2's sums are unchanged

today_morning_trips._note: Shift 1's five trips (they sum to its $831 over 64.3 km), drawn in D1a/D1b under the 11:48 row; with the two verdes that left (today_morning_missed) Tu día at 14:40 lists every offer of the day so far, 10 rows down to 08:15, and scrolls (Round 20, Opus N6)

today_by_app_1440._note: Round 24c (Opus 322): every trip of 19 oct is Uber (C1–C3 are Uber offers and G4 reads «DiDi · Esperando una oferta»), so at 14:40 Uber has the whole $979 and DiDi none

today_morning_missed._note: The two verde offers that left without being taken (D1's observation '2 ofertas verdes se fueron sin tomar'), both in shift 1

v4._about: Inputs the simple set needs beyond v3. One money definition: what the trips paid minus gasoline and wear; the car's weekly cost is never subtracted from a figure, only drawn on the week.

window._about: Comparar reads the last 4 weeks. The reader has data from 1 Oct, so the window is the three weeks below; the weekday and hour-block rows must add up to those weeks' totals (check.py asserts it).

second_app_offer._about: S5: the founder's real 12:49 offer of 9 Nov 2026 on a dark-card app

imss_2026._about: The rule as the founder states it (2026-11-09): what an app paid in the month (trips, incentives and referral incentives; no tips) x (1 - cost deduction) x (1 - IVA) must reach CDMX's monthly minimum wage. Counted per app, as the app does today. Served from remote config.

examples._about: Not derived from anything: placeholders that a real cohort or another driver would replace.

city_open._about: Tu ciudad once a cohort exists. The overall percentile is derived (linear interpolation between the deciles of what the apps pay per km, before costs); the per-slice percentiles are given, since each would need its own deciles.

today_second_app_offers._about: Offers of 19 Oct from the second app, so the day's list names both. None was taken, so no money figure changes (the day's trips are all Uber, as in v3).

imss_incentives_entered._about: Typed by the driver for October: the reader only sees offers, never incentives or referral bonuses.

chip_basis._about: Founder, 2026-11-09: the driver chooses whether the chip shows neto (after their cost per km) or bruto (the fare over the km), where the limits and the costs are set; the chip says the word. Limits are kept in the chosen measure. Switching proposes the other measure's limits: neto + cost, rounded to the half peso.

pon_tu_precio._about: Founder, 2026-11-09: on a DiDi Pon Tu Precio offer the chip also shows the counter-offer that reaches the mínimo and the one that reaches the meta, each rounded up to the next peso. Only the ones still ahead are shown. S5 uses second_app_offer, S9 uses today_second_app_offers 12:25.
